Opium of the People?: The dictatorship of the proletariat has seized the state, and now the question of the hour is the question of the altar. The party's philosophers quote Marx: religion is the sigh of the oppressed creature, the opium of the people. Shall the revolution march into the churches and proclaim the end of God - or is freedom of conscience the revolution's first promise?
Religion is the opium of the people - close the churches!
Freedom of conscience is the revolution's first promise.
